stale.title: Playlists to delete in rekordbox
stale.hint: In rekordbox, right-click each of these playlists and choose Delete Playlist. They come from crates that were renamed or deleted, and an import will not delete them for you.
stale.unchecked: Not checked yet (no rekordbox export read)

removals.title: Tracks to remove in rekordbox
removals.hint: In rekordbox, select these tracks, right-click and choose Remove from Collection. They were removed from your Library, and an import will not remove them for you.
